accepted_existing_results: FST, ROH, selection, notes, reports, or manuscript claims
declared_input_requirements.raw_genomic_files: inventory-only; raw genomic contents are not parsed

missing_input_rules: If metadata is absent, allow technical audit but block group-level interpretation.
If raw genotype inputs are absent, do not propose raw-data execution.
If provenance is missing, require uncertainty language in the final report.
preflight_checks: Confirm raw genomic files remain inventory-only.
Require human expert review before any result claim is used.

dry_run_steps.title: Inventory existing result files
dry_run_steps.description: List declared PCA, ADMIXTURE, PLINK summary, FST, ROH, selection, and claim documents without raw genomic parsing.

dry_run_steps.title: Audit interpretation claims
dry_run_steps.description: Compare declared result types to allowed cautious claims and block unsafe identity, clinical, ancestry, selection, and endogamy interpretations.

command_preview_templates.description: Dry-run only reminder that already-generated outputs may be audited but genomics tools are not executed.
command_preview_templates.preview: # DRY-RUN ONLY: audit declared result files and claims; do not execute PLINK, ADMIXTURE, smartpca, vcftools, or other tools.

allowed_with_review: Existing results can be reviewed for provenance, missing metadata, and overclaim risk.
soften: Convert PCA or ADMIXTURE assertions into cautious statements about exploratory structure patterns.
block: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components

blocked_interpretations: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components
scientific_validity_notes: Existing results are not biological proof without provenance, metadata, sample-size context, and human expert review.
external_llm_called=false by default; external_tools_executed=false; raw genomic files are inventory-only.
human_review_checklist: Human expert review required: confirm input provenance and whether metadata supports the audit.
Check that PCA clusters are not treated as identity labels.
Check that ADMIXTURE components are not treated as literal ancestry.
Confirm clinical diagnosis, treatment recommendation, consumer ancestry, caste/community/religion, genetic purity/superiority, unsupported selection, and unsupported endogamy claims are blocked.

provenance_sources.title: ADMIXTURE documentation
provenance_sources.note: Supports cautious treatment of Q matrices and CV outputs as model summaries, not literal ancestry.
